headlines.title: Meta agrees to settle social media addiction claims with states for up to $18 billion
headlines.description: Meta Platforms, the owner of Facebook and Instagram has agreed to settle a series of social media addiction claims for up to $18 billion.

headlines.title: Meta agrees to pay $18 billion to settle social media addiction lawsuit
headlines.description: Meta has agreed to settle the social media addiction trial brought forward by California and other states for nearly $18 billion. NBC News' Allie Canal and Misty Marris have details on the settlement and what it means for the social media giant.

headlines.title: Dolly Parton Died After ‘Brief Battle With Cancer,’ Her Team Says
headlines.description: Legendary singer, songwriter, businesswoman and philanthropist Dolly Parton died at 80 surrounded by loved ones in a Nashville hospital. Her team confirming, “After bravely facing a brief battle with cancer, Dolly departed her earthly life.” Tributes are pouring in from throughout the entertainment world including from her “Steel Magnolias” co-star Sally Field and fellow music legend Paul McCartney. NBC’s Joe Fryer reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Mudslides and flash flooding cause devastation in Nepal and China's Tibet
headlines.description: A wall of mud and rock appeared to collapse ​into a river on the Himalayan border of Nepal and China’s Tibet, triggering catastrophic flooding on the Nepali side that killed at least 31 people and left ‌hundreds of tourists missing, including Americans.

headlines.title: How to Get a Real Customer Service Person on the Phone
headlines.description: Navigating customer service isn’t always easy, so NBC’s Vicky Nguyen stops by TODAY to share how to get a real person on the phone, the best way to talk to chatbots, and tips for getting what you need.

headlines.title: Upgrade Your Wardrobe and Accessories for Fall with These Deals
headlines.description: Fall is right around the corner, and now is the perfect time to stock up on new fashion and accessories. TODAY lifestyle and commerce contributor Jill Martin stops by Studio 1A for the latest installment of Jill’s Steals & Deals. Get the best deals on jeans, totes, jewelry, and more!

headlines.title: SpaceX wants to turn Louisiana marshland into a Starship hub
headlines.description: SpaceX's Elon Musk plans to build new Starship launchpads in Louisiana, replacing sections of marshland as part of a major spaceport project. Space journalist Kristin Fisher talks with NBC News' Gadi Schwartz about the plans.

headlines.title: Gen Z’s Analog Summer Filled With Throwback Tech and Hobbies
headlines.description: Despite all of the technology at their fingertips, it appears a lot of younger people are choosing more hands-on hobbies synonymous with their parents and even grandparents, from needlepoint to birdwatching. NBC’s Joe Fryer reports for TODAY on the rising popularity of analog activities.

headlines.title: The Future Is Here: Air Taxis Unveiled in Downtown Los Angeles
headlines.description: An air taxi was unveiled Monday in downtown Los Angeles. Developers plan to put landing sites all over the city and are hoping to have it ready to go in time for the 2028 Olympics, pending FAA approval.

headlines.title: Amazon’s steering wheel-free robotaxi expands to more cities
headlines.description: Amazon's Zoox robotaxis are now hitting the streets in cities like Las Vegas and San Francisco, becoming some of the first self-driving vehicles approved for commercial use without a steering wheel or dashboard. NBC News' Chief Tech correspondent Joanna Stern talks with Tom Llamas about the new cars.

headlines.title: Phone Safety Settings Guide: What to Turn On vs. Keep Off
headlines.description: There are countless safety and privacy settings on our phones and devices so NBC’s business and data correspondent Brian Cheung stops by TODAY to share the best practices for protecting your privacy, including deleting unused apps, turning on multi-factor authentication, shutting off data tracking, and more.
